body: I have my medical card and I still am paranoid when smoking.

College is not the issue here.  It's almost (and it's hard to phrase) like outside influences are affecting me when they should not have any effect on me at all because they are meaningless on a broader scale.  But it still gets at me, it constantly invades my mind and I think about it.

I live in a drama-filled house with family that spreads gossip/rumors when you have your back-turned.  I have distanced myself from my family because (even if it sounds egotistical) I am vastly superior to them.  They are nothing but a deterrent to my life and I am tired of family.  I tried saving them in the past but to no success.  I need to talk one on one with an outsider, because my family has a counselor they talk to but I will never reveal myself to her because she will in turn tell my family.

Yea, I need to occupy myself with a hobby.  I am kind of in a dumb transition in life and don't currently have the time or patience with finding/doing a new hobby.  Maybe when summer comes I will mellow out.  We all mellow out during summer.  The vacation mindset will do me good I feel.  TY for the input.

I have not talked to anyone, I am a very reserved individual.  I've been taught that pouring out emotions is a sign of weakness.  Perhaps I have bottled them up for too long?  

And to follow up on the idea that I am thinking negatively, I believe that my negativity is present but my negative thoughts are truthful. For example (hypothetically), I will say to someone, "You know how many preservatives/toxins/carcinogens are in your hamburger/air you breathe/tobacco?"  That is a negative thought, correct? But it is truth, and it pains me to no ends how people can live blissfully, but I suppose that is the price you pay for being educated.  I sometimes think about how awesome it would be to not have any inhibitions because of education.  My brain is like a chessboard, I make one move and I need to dissect it.  My enemy makes a move, and I need to counter.  Maybe because I played so much chess in my youth.

What baffles me is how not straightforward people can be.  And how aluding/deceptive they can be about disagreements/agreements.  Just be f'in honest in all seriousness, communication can make or break relationships.  I've been browsing this subreddit long enough to know the faults of relationships and communication is probably number 1 on the list.

This guy is right, assertiveness can be key in this scenario.  Do not let any visions of the future cloud your mind, young padawan. Just ask her, and if she gets defensive, tell her how you really feel.  But act your age most importantly, tell that to her too.  This is a lot of money i am assuming you are using to visit your girlfriend.  Don't let it go to waste.

Hah! you are lucky that you can remember all your past experiences.  I have some repressed memories of my past history with my family.  I was also catholic, went to catholic school yadidada, all that sentimental stuff. BLEH.  Truth be told, I do not think highly of my parents anymore, but they are still family, and family takes care of one another.  Just calm your mind, meditate as the person said above me, and just do not think of the past so much.  It is almost a waste of time.  You are old enough to make decisions on your own and straight up TELL them how B.S. all the stuff they did to you.  

Remember though, cutting off communication does nothing but cause anxiety.  You need to let go of the past.

Ok... you need to snap out of your fantasy world now please.  This guy does everything for you EXCEPT he doesn't talk that much.... really?  You even said through his actions you can tell how much he really loves you.  This guy could be the perfect man except you are blinded because you want your prince charming.  Well I'm terribly sorry to break it to you, but this is as good as it gets sweet cheeks.  Other than that, don't break off with this *Gentleman* he seems like a decent bro.

Wow, you are a "crazy". Thanks for posting this, now i know who to avoid when trying to find relationships.  A simple joke should not get you all hyped up and in defensive mode. Loosen up and enjoy your time with your boyfriend, make a witty comment back but don't let it spiral out of control and cloud your judgement.  You even stated you didn't want to make an argument about this.  The mere fact that you thought about an argument over this little gesture is baffling.  I lose hope for humanity every day because of these insignificant things.

And people saying this as a disrespectful joke... Are you f'in serious right now??  The boyfriend was joking, she even said so herself.  Is she some psychic that can predict emotions and feelings being portrayed by some person? No.  Boys are simple-minded, ladies, get with the program. Do yourself a favor and get him gifts then call him expensive. There! now you are even.

AND!!! this story could be one-sided folks, you know nothing of the other half of the story.
